title: Guard agent-model-cap stops asking on test strings passed to an interpreter
why: Incident, Nov 2 01:16 CST: in trial run gd a round-2 reviewer ran python3 -c with JSON test payloads piped into hooks/guard.py; guard agent-model-cap read one payload (a settings file raising the subagent model to Opus) as a real write and asked. Nothing writes settings, and the run stalled on a prompt only the owner can answer (Queue item 162). Same class as step env-heredoc-false-alarm: string data handed to an interpreter read as an act.
note: A guard verdict change: red first on this form. Share the fix with step env-heredoc-false-alarm if one rule covers both: interpreter string data that writes no file is not the act. Ready. Port: yes. Lane [ended:lane:-agent-model-cap-string-false-alarm], started by the coordinator Nov 3 16:57 CST. Also takes the env-heredoc-false-alarm leftover branches. Sighting (coordinator, 11:12 CST Nov 8): lane notes-fix-reverify-large ([ended:lane:-notes-fix-reverify-large]) has waited since 04:23 CST on an agent-model-cap prompt for a read-only `python3 - <<'PYEOF'` probe that only passes the string `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL":"opus"` to guard.cap_change(); no settings file is written (rule building-scanner-respects-strings). Triage sweep 03:45 CST Nov 10: back to ready; no lane named, no open PR (open PRs read pages 1-8, 725 PRs). Coordinator started lane [ended:agent-model-cap-string-false-alarm] at 03:46-03:49 CST Nov 10. Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was [ended:agent-model-cap-string-false-alarm]). Owner 15:53 CST Nov 12 (retrospective): a prompt asked him to let hooks/probe.py write CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL (Opus, until 2027-01-14) into .claude/settings.local.json; it came from lane fixed-number-limits-census running probe.py with a quoted command. probe.py never runs its command: a form the fix misses, or a stale install in that lane. Page item 656 closed.
